description: v0.8 Octopus-absent fallback path: user asks for a multi-objective Octopus optimization, but gh_plugin_check reports Octopus is not installed (only Galapagos is). The assistant pivots to a single-objective gh_galapagos_setup with a weighted-composite fitness clause, then ends the turn explaining the fallback. Exercises the parti-optimize persona's documented 'fall back to Galapagos when Octopus/Wallacei aren't installed' behavior.
userPrompt: Use Octopus to optimize three objectives: daylight, structural depth, and facade area.

interactions.text: Let me first check whether Octopus is available on this machine.
Octopus is not installed on this machine. I'll fall back to Galapagos with a single-objective weighted composite of the three metrics (daylight + structural depth + facade area).

Octopus is not installed, so I used the documented fallback: a single-objective Galapagos setup with a weighted composite fitness function combining daylight, structural depth, and facade area. If you want true multi-objective Pareto fronts, install Octopus from Food4Rhino and we can redo this.
